messages:
elaine: Heads up — planning convo re: rollout safeguards for the next model transition. Key asks we need to settle: tenant opt-out paths, fast rollback, and an acceptance window for benchmarks. Can we sketch constraints + owner?

miguel: +1. My rough proposal: a stability budget that triggers a rollback if top-5 paying tenants see >0.75% correctness drop OR if P95 latency increases >30% vs baseline.

neha: For benchmarks I'd like a two-tier suite: 'smoke' (fast, top-500 prompts) and 'stress' (longer tails + adversarial). Acceptance: smoke pass rate >= 98% over a 48h rolling window.

sam: From solutions side — customers will expect an opt-out toggle per-tenant and a one-click revert in Console. Is that feasible to ship before the pilot? :eyes: 

capri: One-click revert is doable but depends on scope. We can implement route-level pinning first (per-route override + audit log). Full tenant-wide shim needs more infra time.

jonas: CS input: customers want a 2-week opt-in preview window with explicit comms and a support playbook. Also require audit logs for any automatic fallback/rollback.

miguel: Routing fallback sketch: default -> new-model -> compat-adapter -> legacy-model. Detection + divert timing: detection hook ~5s, start divert within 30s, full cutover rules configurable.

neha: Also note quantization delta: embed vector drift and n-gram quality need thresholds. We'll tag model artifacts with quant-level and require a per-variant quality delta < 0.6% on our embed-sim metric.

elaine: Love the specifics. Let's make explicit launch gates: perf (P95 within X%), quality (smoke + stress), opt-in coverage (preview pool), infra rollback path, and comms readiness. I'll draft the checklist.

sam: Suggest adding a 'grace rollback budget' — allow short, rate-limited latency increases per-tenant during ramp (e.g., 10 minutes of elevated P95 before rollback), so small spikes don't auto-kill a rollout.

miguel: Agree. Proposed ramp policy: 10% traffic for 1h, 30% for 4h, 100% after 24h unless regression alerts fire. Add per-tenant thresholds to opt-out.

jonas: I'll draft the 'what to expect' email + migration FAQ. Also propose a checkbox in the opt-in flow: "I want automatic reversion if my SLA breaches" so we capture customer preferences.

elaine: Action items: Miguel — feasibility & infra plan for one-click revert and per-route pinning, EOD Friday. Neha — extend stress tests to a tenant-sampled cohort and add quant-delta checks, due Mon. Sam/Jonas — comms + opt-in copy. I'll produce the launch-gate checklist and link it here.

miguel: Also adding a short rollout config snippet we can validate in staging:
```
rollout_policy:
  phases:
    - pct: 10
      duration: 1h
    - pct: 30
      duration: 4h
    - pct: 100
      duration: 24h
  auto_rollback_on:
    - metric: top_tenant_quality_drop
      threshold: 0.75
    - metric: p95_latency_increase_pct
      threshold: 30
```

capri: We'll need a small K/V flag and an audit event for any manual revert. I'll prototype the API endpoint.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: catalog-transition-checks v0.1 -> staging at 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC

elaine: Thanks all. Let's reconvene after Miguel's feasibility note. If anyone wants to add gating items (security/compliance hooks), drop them here before EOD. :thumbsup:
